title: Recovered work
originalRequest: Develop a reliable online booking and management system for the local village hall, handling reservations, calendar schedules, and secure payments.
latestMessage: Develop a reliable online booking and management system for the local village hall, handling reservations, calendar schedules, and secure payments.

steps.title: Database Schema Setup for Bookings
steps.instruction: Define the PostgreSQL database schema for the booking system, including tables for users, halls, bookings, and payments. Ensure foreign key constraints and indexes on booking date ranges are configured.
steps.acceptance: Database migration script executes successfully and all tables are verified in the database schema.

steps.title: Calendar Availability API Endpoint
steps.instruction: Implement a REST API endpoint to query booking availability for specific halls within a requested date range.
steps.acceptance: API returns correct vacant slots and excludes already booked time ranges, validated by unit tests.

steps.title: Concurrency Control for Double-Bookings
steps.instruction: Develop a concurrency resolution mechanism to prevent two users from booking the same hall at the same time.
steps.acceptance: Integration tests simulating high-concurrency reservation attempts successfully block double-bookings and return a conflict error.

steps.title: Stripe Webhook Integration
steps.instruction: Set up a Stripe webhook handler to confirm bookings once payment is processed successfully.
steps.acceptance: Webhook endpoint processes test payment events and correctly updates booking statuses to confirmed.
